##### Project general facts

Belmore Residences is a residential development featuring 210 units with one-, two-, and three-bedroom layouts. The project combines modern architecture with elegant interiors and thoughtfully designed living spaces. Its residences offer views of Ras Al Khor Wildlife Sanctuary, the Downtown Dubai skyline, and the Dubai Creek skyline, creating a distinctive setting that brings together urban living and natural surroundings.

The development offers a range of amenities designed to support an active and balanced lifestyle. Residents can enjoy a resort-style swimming pool, a rooftop club lounge, a sky lounge, and a cinema room. Additional facilities include a modern fitness centre, yoga studios, and dedicated children's play areas, providing spaces for relaxation, exercise, and family activities.

The residences feature modern finishes and high-quality materials, reflecting a contemporary approach to comfort and functionality. The kitchens are equipped with modern appliances, while the units are offered unfurnished, allowing residents to personalise their interiors. The development also incorporates retail spaces and pet-friendly areas, adding convenience and flexibility to everyday living.

##### Location description and benefits

Belmore Residences is located in Meydan, Dubai, a district known for its modern residential developments, open spaces, and convenient access to key destinations across the city. The area combines an urban lifestyle with a more relaxed residential atmosphere, appealing to those seeking a balance between city connectivity and everyday comfort.

One of Meydan's most recognisable landmarks is Meydan Racecourse, home to prestigious horse racing events, including the Dubai World Cup. The surrounding district offers a distinctive lifestyle shaped by sporting events, hospitality venues, and leisure destinations, contributing to the area's established profile within Dubai.

Meydan also features landscaped outdoor areas and green spaces that provide opportunities for walking, cycling, and outdoor recreation. Residents benefit from access to dining venues, hotels, retail destinations, and wellness facilities in the wider area. Its road connections provide convenient access to other parts of Dubai, including Downtown Dubai, making the location suitable for residents seeking both accessibility and a comfortable residential environment.
